subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined word.

The old library had a __musty__ smell from years of neglect.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Stale)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"musty"** means having a stale, moldy, or damp smell, often associated with places that have been neglected or unused for a long time. (बासी/सड़ा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The basement had a musty odor due to water leakage and lack of ventilation.
 
 
 
• **"Stale"** refers to something that is no longer fresh, often used to describe food, air, or smells that have become unpleasant due to age or neglect. (बासी)
 
 
• **Example: **The bread was stale because it had been left out for days.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "stale" is the best one-word substitute for "musty."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Stale)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Casual** (अनौपचारिक): Relaxed and unconcerned; without formality or seriousness.

 
 
• **Example:** He wore casual clothes to the party instead of formal attire.
 
 
 
• **Foggy** (धुंधला): Filled with fog; unclear or lacking clarity.
 
 
• **Example:** The road was hard to see because of the foggy weather.
 
 
 
• **Fresh** (ताजा): Something new, clean, or recently made.
 
 
• **Example:** She bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
